description: Stable shared meanings for Quality Studio observations; scoring and enforcement remain in versioned policies.

axes.description: The explicit kind of actor or system that produced a fact.

terms.title: Agent
terms.description: A model-backed review agent produced the fact.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A repeatable tool or rule-based sensor produced the fact.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A person directly supplied the fact.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: A migration adapter preserved the fact from a legacy contract.

terms.title: Unknown
terms.description: Available provenance cannot establish the producer kind.

axes.description: The availability and completeness of evidence, independent of assessment or policy disposition.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: The evidence expected by the profile is available.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some expected evidence is absent or could not be preserved.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: Applicable evidence could not be obtained.

axes.description: What the available evidence establishes about conformance or quality.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: Applicable evidence supports the expected condition.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: Evidence establishes a material concern without establishing failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: Evidence establishes that the expected condition is not met.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The available evidence cannot establish pass, concern, or fail.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The assessed condition does not apply to the subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: No assessment of the applicable condition has been completed.

axes.description: The observed direction of a before-and-after comparison.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: The compared quality outcome improved.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: The compared quality outcome regressed.

terms.title: Mixed
terms.description: The comparison contains both improvements and regressions.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: The comparison establishes no meaningful directional change.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: No quality delta was observed in the compared scope.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The evidence is insufficient to determine a direction of change.

axes.description: An optional policy disposition that is separate from the evidence assessment.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: The referenced policy permits the reviewed operation or delivery.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: The referenced policy permits continuation with an explicit warning.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: The referenced policy prevents continuation.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: The referenced policy postpones a disposition pending another condition.

axes.description: The impact ordering of an observed finding; weights remain policy-owned.

terms.title: Critical
terms.description: The finding has critical impact under the producing profile.

terms.title: High
terms.description: The finding has high impact under the producing profile.

terms.title: Medium
terms.description: The finding has medium impact under the producing profile.

terms.title: Low
terms.description: The finding has low impact under the producing profile.

terms.title: Informational
terms.description: The finding is informational under the producing profile.

axes.description: Human- or policy-backed issue lifecycle state, stored outside immutable observations.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: The issue is active and has no accepted terminal disposition.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: An authorized actor accepted the issue's risk.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: An authorized actor temporarily or conditionally waived the issue.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: An authorized actor determined that the issue does not represent the claimed condition.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: Explicit evidence and policy establish that the issue is resolved.

axes.description: The stable kind of a typed evidence reference.

terms.title: Source code
terms.description: A source path, symbol, or range supports the result.

terms.title: Test result
terms.description: A test execution result supports the result.

terms.title: Runtime measurement
terms.description: A runtime observation or measurement supports the result.

terms.title: Tool result
terms.description: A deterministic tool payload supports the result.

terms.title: Artifact
terms.description: A separately stored artifact supports the result.

terms.title: Document
terms.description: A document or preserved textual record supports the result.

terms.title: Human attestation
terms.description: A named human attestation supports the result.

aspects.title: Correctness
aspects.description: Behavioral correctness and defect risk in code.

aspects.title: Architecture
aspects.description: Architectural fit, dependency direction, and maintainable structure.

aspects.title: General security
aspects.description: Security concerns not assigned to a narrower core aspect.

aspects.title: Secrets
aspects.description: Credential, token, and secret exposure or handling.

aspects.title: Dependencies
aspects.description: Known vulnerability and supply-chain risk in dependencies.

aspects.title: Authentication and authorization
aspects.description: Identity establishment and enforcement of caller authority.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Validation and safe handling of untrusted input.

aspects.title: Configuration and infrastructure as code
aspects.description: Security of effective configuration and infrastructure definitions.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Reachability and control posture of externally callable boundaries.

aspects.title: Business logic security
aspects.description: Abuse resistance and security of multi-step business flows.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Evidence coverage for applicable attack scenarios.

aspects.title: General performance
aspects.description: Runtime efficiency, scalability, and resource-use concerns.

aspects.title: Change risk
aspects.description: Risk introduced or mitigated by a change set.

aspects.title: Change test evidence
aspects.description: Adequacy and relevance of test evidence for a change set.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: Whether a change remains coherent and proportionate to its stated scope.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: Architectural drift introduced or reduced by a change set.
